summary.text: JJ Galvez is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 71 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Kate Sanchez.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an immigrant from Honduras with a career in technology.

paragraphs.text: JJ Galvez earned a bachelor's degree from Loyola Marymount University in 2014.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Honduras, attended college in California on scholarships and part-time jobs, and built a career in technology leading teams at small startups and large companies.
Galvez advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
In the survey, he said he would focus on lowering the cost of living and promoting job growth in sectors resilient to automation and AI.
